title: Abid ke Sath Aaye Aseerane Karbala
body:
Abid key sath aaye aseeran-e-Karbala
Hein sath sath unke garebaan-e-Karbala
<<MINI>>
Bimar laasakey na Sakina ko apne sath…..
Bimar laasakey na Sakina ko apne sath…..
<<DIVIDER>>
Aye gham guzar-e-Zainab-e-Zeeshan-e-Karbala
<<MINI>>
Barchi ka phal jo dekhi jigar phat gaya suno…..
Barchi ka phal jo dekhi jigar phat gaya suno…..
<<DIVIDER>>
Ta zeest lab pe laila key nouha ye rehgaya
<<MINI>>
Qasim ki laash hogayi paamal run mein jo…..
Qasim ki laash hogayi paamal run mein jo…..
<<DIVIDER>>
Kubra kamush hogayi laasha wo aagaya
<<MINI>>
Asghar tumari yaad mein baano tadapti hai…..
Asghar tumari yaad mein baano tadapti hai…..
<<DIVIDER>>
Qaaboun me unke aate hai furqaan-e-Karbala
<<MINI>>
Zainab key laal aun-o-mohammed Hussain key…...
Zainab key laal aun-o-mohammed Hussain key…...
<<DIVIDER>>
Duniya mein dono ban gaye pehchan-e-Karbala
Kya kya mila na usko dare shah-e-deen par…… kya kya mila na usko dare shah-e-deen par…… Iqbal jee raha hai baa ehsan-e-Karbala
